change.heading: Net Stable Funding Requirements

applies_from.reason: the text changed beyond its dates, so no date that moved can be read as the application date

sentences.text: Paragraph 6 changes the EBA's single 28 June 2023 report into a recurring obligation, requiring it to report to the Commission by 31 January 2029 and every five years thereafter on the appropriateness of the stable funding requirement for securities financing transactions and related unsecured transactions with financial customers.
